exported_guarantees.statement: Actor-to-actor information moves through an explicit sender-to-receiver asserted-claim transfer after a sender-owned decision and a valid communication opportunity or channel.
The receiver owns epistemic interpretation through PA-04 and may consume only actor-accessible inputs; transport does not decide acceptance for the receiver.
Receiving information does not authorize retransmission; any later retell is a new actor-owned decision with its own target and opportunity.
Privileged engine causal lineage and actor-accessible or reported provenance are distinct authorities; engine-known lineage is not actor knowledge by default.
With all actor-visible inputs fixed, changing only privileged engine lineage must not change receiver belief, confidence, corroboration, dialogue or action output.
False or partial assertions may propagate and revise receiver belief without repetition or transport mutating canonical world truth.
Technical loop, repeat, time and budget guards may bound operations but do not replace sender motive, opportunity or receiver ownership with a propagation manager.
PA-04 perception and public acquisition remain distinct from PA-05 actor-to-actor communication transfer; existence of a source does not broadcast knowledge.
Player-originated information uses the same communication and receiver-acquisition owners as NPC information rather than a privileged quest-only rumour channel.

exclusions_nonclaims.statement: Automatic graph diffusion and a global RumourManager choosing targets or acceptance are rejected as baseline authority.
Repetition of an assertion does not change canonical truth.
The sender or transport cannot own the receiver's epistemic result.
Hidden root, parent, lineage, lie or truth diagnostics cannot enter actor-facing epistemic reasoning unless legitimately acquired.
Dialogue or quest rumour flags may not become a mutable authority parallel to PA-04 belief state.
PA-05 transfer history is not permanent actor biography; PA-06 owns lasting autobiographical memory, salience, forgetting and compaction.
PA-05 does not select final runtime event transport, schema, storage, APIs, numeric formulas, persistence strategy or population-scale implementation.

reopen_conditions: Concrete accepted evidence shows that explicit opportunity-bound transfer and receiver-owned interpretation cannot preserve the required selective information-flow semantics.
A later accepted consumer requires privileged hidden lineage to alter actor epistemic output rather than an actor-accessible provenance path.
Accepted composition with PA-06 or PA-09 falsifies the separation between transfer, autobiographical memory and generic player-action ownership.
escalate_if: A consumer needs exact PA-05 semantics beyond the exported guarantees and complete mechanism disposition table.
A disposition would be reclassified, especially any REJECT or LATER/conditional row.
A proposed consumer introduces global broadcast, automatic retell, hidden-lineage epistemic use, duplicate rumour state or a player-only information authority.
Live accepted identity or canonical PA-05 source bytes contradict this capsule.
